devicesPage.title: My Devices
devicesPage.subtitle: Connect watches, rings, glucose sensors, and home health devices so BioMath Core can read trends and explain them in plain language.
devicesPage.catalogIntro: What people use today — and which signals each category usually provides. Use this to choose gear that matches your goals, then connect a supported brand below.
devicesPage.signalsIntro: These are the capabilities BioMath Core uses most often when a device is connected.
devicesPage.emptyBrands: Live brand connections are not available in this session. You can still explore the guide above and connect later from Member Zone when signed in.
devicesPage.chooseBrand: Choose a manufacturer to authorize. Supported families include Apple, Samsung, Google, Fitbit, Garmin, Oura, Ultrahuman, WHOOP, Dexcom, FreeStyle Libre, Withings, Omron, and more.

recommendations.title: How to choose
recommendations.intro: If you do not own a device yet, start with the outcome you care about most:

values.sleep: Oura Ring, Ultrahuman Ring, WHOOP, or Eight Sleep
values.activity: Apple Watch, Garmin, Samsung Galaxy Watch, Fitbit, or Polar
values.glucose: Dexcom G7 or FreeStyle Libre (continuous glucose)
values.blood_pressure: Omron or Withings BPM (validated cuff-style monitors)
values.long_term: Smart rings and recovery bands worn day and night
values.universal: Apple Watch or Samsung Galaxy Watch plus a smart scale

continuous_glucose.title: Continuous glucose
continuous_glucose.body: Day-long glucose curves from CGMs — useful for meals, energy dips, and metabolic patterns.

sleep_stages.title: Sleep stages
sleep_stages.body: Duration, deep/REM balance, and overnight consistency from watches, rings, and sleep systems.

hrv_recovery.title: HRV & recovery
hrv_recovery.body: Heart-rate variability and recovery scores that hint when to push and when to rest.

blood_pressure.title: Blood pressure
blood_pressure.body: Home cuff readings that track vascular comfort over weeks — not a one-off snapshot.

body_composition.title: Weight & composition
body_composition.body: Smart scales for weight, lean mass, and body-composition trends.

activity_load.title: Activity load
activity_load.body: Steps, workouts, and strain so load can be balanced with recovery.

smartwatch.title: Smartwatches
smartwatch.body: All-day heart rate, sleep, activity, and often ECG or SpO₂ on the wrist.

smart_ring.title: Smart rings
smart_ring.body: Discreet 24/7 wear for sleep, HRV, temperature, and recovery.

recovery.title: Recovery bands
recovery.body: Strain and recovery focused bands worn continuously.

cgm.title: Continuous glucose
cgm.body: Clinical-style sensors that stream glucose without finger sticks for most of the day.

blood_pressure.title: Blood pressure monitors
blood_pressure.body: Validated home cuffs for reliable systolic/diastolic tracking.

body_composition.title: Smart scales
body_composition.body: Weight and body-composition estimates for longer trends.

sleep_home.title: Home sleep systems
sleep_home.body: Bed-based tracking for sleep quality and overnight vitals without a wrist device.

apple_watch.name: Apple Watch
apple_watch.blurb: Broad everyday coverage: heart rate, HRV, sleep, SpO₂, ECG, and workouts.

samsung_galaxy_watch.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch
samsung_galaxy_watch.blurb: Wrist metrics plus select models with cuffless blood-pressure support where available.

garmin.name: Garmin
garmin.blurb: Training load, recovery, sleep, and HRV suited to endurance and structured sport.

google_pixel_watch.name: Google Pixel Watch
google_pixel_watch.blurb: Fitbit-backed sleep and activity with a compact smartwatch experience.

oura.name: Oura Ring
oura.blurb: Ring-based sleep staging, readiness, temperature, and HRV.

ultrahuman.name: Ultrahuman Ring
ultrahuman.blurb: Lightweight ring for sleep, recovery, and metabolic-leaning daily signals.

whoop.name: WHOOP
whoop.blurb: Continuous strain, recovery, and sleep coaching without a traditional screen.

dexcom_g7.name: Dexcom G7
dexcom_g7.blurb: Continuous glucose with frequent updates for meal and energy pattern insight.

freestyle_libre.name: FreeStyle Libre
freestyle_libre.blurb: Flash/continuous glucose sensing for day-to-day metabolic awareness.

omron.name: Omron
omron.blurb: Widely used validated blood-pressure cuffs for home monitoring.

withings_bpm.name: Withings BPM
withings_bpm.blurb: Connected cuff readings that sync cleanly into a health history.

withings_body.name: Withings Body+
withings_body.blurb: Smart scale for weight and body-composition trends.

eight_sleep.name: Eight Sleep
eight_sleep.blurb: Bed system tracking sleep stages and overnight vitals.

fitbit.name: Fitbit
fitbit.blurb: Accessible sleep, heart rate, activity, and stress tracking.

polar.name: Polar
polar.blurb: Sport-grade heart rate, training load, and recovery metrics.

explain.howBody: We only request access to health metrics. We do not see or store logins and passwords. You can disconnect the device at any time.
explain.point1: The app collects authorized metrics from your device
explain.point2: We interpret trends and suggest calm next steps
explain.point3: Data can inform reports and Health Guide guidance
explain.privacyBody: You stay in control. We never receive your device password and cannot control the device. We only receive the health data you authorize.

authorize.title: Grant access
authorize.intro: Allow the device to transmit metrics automatically.
authorize.syncBody: Default: daily in the morning. You can change this later:

success.title: Device connected
success.body: BioMath Core will update metrics and use them in recommendations and reports.
success.tipBody: Regular wear helps us track direction — improving, declining, or stable — not only a single day.

footer.howBody: Authorized metrics (sleep, heart rate, stress, recovery, glucose, and more) are collected and explained in plain language. We focus on trends and practical next steps — not raw dumps of numbers.
footer.privacyBody: You control the connection. We do not know your device password and cannot control the device. Disconnect anytime.

connection.body: gives BioMath Core more precise signals. We do not only collect numbers — we explain their meaning and relate them to your state and habits.

deviceHints.opening: You can connect a watch, ring, band, glucose sensor, cuff, or scale. After connecting, BioMath Core updates data and can use it in reports and Health Guide guidance.

success.body: The next sync happens automatically. You do not need to do anything manually.

firstSync.title: Metrics received
firstSync.body: We will track the trend, not just single values.

why.title: Why this matters
why.body: Devices help notice changes early. Think of them as a calm navigator for load, recovery, and gentle adjustments — before symptoms become the first alert.

token_expired.title: Access expired
token_expired.message: Device access has expired. Refresh access so metrics can be read again.

no_data.title: No new data
no_data.message: The device did not send new data today. It may not have been worn or synced. We will try again automatically.

service_error.title: Manufacturer unavailable
service_error.message: The manufacturer is temporarily unavailable. We will retry syncing later.

manual_disconnect.title: Device disconnected
manual_disconnect.message: The device is no longer sending data. You can reconnect anytime.

bluetooth_sync.title: Phone sync
bluetooth_sync.message: The device may not have synced with the phone yet. Open the manufacturer app — the rest usually follows automatically.

sleep_declined.title: Sleep quality decreased
sleep_declined.message: Recent sleep has been less deep. This may reflect nervous-system load. We can suggest gentle recovery steps.

sleep_improved.title: Sleep improved
sleep_improved.message: Sleep looks more stable — a good sign that recovery is improving.

hrv_improved.title: HRV improving
hrv_improved.message: Heart-rate variability improved — a sign the nervous system is recovering.

hrv_declined.title: HRV decreasing
hrv_declined.message: The nervous system may be running hot. Gentle recovery mode is often the better next step.

activity_high.title: Elevated load
activity_high.message: Load is higher than usual — keep recovery in view.

glucose_unstable.title: Glucose fluctuations
glucose_unstable.message: Glucose is swinging. We can help relate meals and habits to the pattern — without diagnosis language.

blood_pressure_stable.title: Blood pressure stable
blood_pressure_stable.message: Stable, normal readings support vascular comfort over time. If readings rise, we explain calmly without fear language.

healthGuide.title: How Health Guide uses device data
healthGuide.template: Based on your latest device data, we see a trend ____________. This is not a diagnosis, but an important signal. Would you like an explanation and recommendations?
healthGuide.agreeBody: I will explain in two ways: (1) physiological analysis (Opinion A) and (2) behavioral and lifestyle explanation (Opinion B). You can compare them and choose what fits.
healthGuide.secondOpinionBody: A second opinion helps view the same signals from physiological and adaptive angles — like two specialists with different thinking styles.
